thread:
IncidentBot: 🚨 SEV2 alert — api-gateway (edge) reporting spike of 502/504s. 60s window avg 5xx rate = 18%. Paging #oncall.
Alex W: seeing the alert, jumping in. any idea scope?
Jordan (SRE): I can take lead for triage. Sam — are you oncall?
Sam O (oncall): oncall here. I got the pager. Confirming increased 502s from edge -> upstream timeouts. Pulling graphs: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/edge/requests
Mira C: product here — any customer-facing impact known yet? CS wants a brief to post to status.
Jordan (SRE): early look: front-door latencies up, a subset of connections to pool eu-west-2-edge show 502 burst. Origin (model-ingest) 504s also ticked. Could be connection exhaustion or a bad rollout.
Alex W: any deploys in last 12h?
Sam O (oncall): deploy bot shows no primary deploys in the past 3h. Rolling config change to edge-cache at 23:12 UTC — marking possible suspect.
Jordan (SRE): running quick checks:
```
# curl check to a sample failing route
curl -sv -H "Host: api.redwood.ai" "https://edge-eu-west-2.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -o /dev/null
# sample gateway response headers show 502
```
Jordan (SRE): stack traces show gateway replied with `upstream prematurely closed connection` and `recv() failed (104: Connection reset by peer)` from a subset of edge proxies.
Anna P: CS reports ~12 customers opened tickets; top impacted customers: acme-inc, learnlytics, memo.ai.
Alex W: mitigation plan? we should follow runbook for ingress 5xx wave. Steps: 1) pin traffic away from suspect edge pool 2) enable fallback pool 3) roll back last config 4) add temporary rate limit on bursts 5) scale up pool.
Sam O (oncall): executing step 1: shifting 25% of traffic away from eu-west-2-edge to eu-west-1-edge via routing policy now. will monitor.
IncidentBot: Routing change applied — traffic shift 25% -> eu-west-1-edge.
Jordan (SRE): checking error rate post-shift — 502 rate drops to 9% in shifted portion, overall down to 13% after 2 minutes. Good signal.
Sam O (oncall): enabling fallback pool (lower-capacity but stable) for affected routes.
IncidentBot: Fallback pool enabled for route /v1/generate on eu-west region.
Mira C: can we craft a short status for status.redwood.ai — what to say for customers?
Anna P: suggested blurb: "We are investigating increased 5xx rates affecting some API requests in EU. We have applied routing mitigations and are monitoring. Some requests may have experienced errors or delays. Updates every 30 minutes."
Alex W: agree. Jordan — can you and Sam confirm whether to roll back the edge-cache config?
Jordan (SRE): logs from the config rollout show config-miner reported `connection_pool` change at 23:12 and a subset of proxies restarted. I'm going to revert that config now to test.
Sam O (oncall): performing rollback to previous edge-cache config (rev: 2024-08-21-rc3). Command: `deployctl rollback edge-cache eu-west-2 --rev 2024-08-21-rc3`
Alex W: tagging @mira and @anna for customer comms. After rollback we should see further improvement.
Jordan (SRE): rollback applied. Observability: after 90s 502 rate in eu-west-2 fell from 20% -> 6% and overall 5xx now 5.2%.
Sam O (oncall): scaling eu-west-1-edge by +2 nodes as buffer in case traffic is shifted back.
IncidentBot: autoscaling action requested: +2 nodes to eu-west-1-edge; status: accepted.
Mira C: product note — any feature degradation? Are tool-calls and streaming impacted?
Jordan (SRE): streaming endpoint latency briefly increased but error rate for streaming is within acceptable thresholds now. We'll keep watch.
Alex W: customer impact summary for post-incident: approx 8–12% of requests in EU experienced 502/504s over ~45 minutes window. Top impacted customers: acme-inc, learnlytics, memo.ai. No data loss; retries are recommended.
Anna P: CS drafted message and will send via helpdesk to affected customers.
Sam O (oncall): putting mitigation in stable state: revert temporary rate limit after rollback confirmation, keep fallback enabled as precaution for 60m.
Jordan (SRE): preparing quick postmortem draft — suspected root cause: config change to edge connection pool + rolling restarts of a subset of proxies causing transient connection resets & upstream overload. Next steps: 1) tighter canary for edge config rollouts 2) circuit-breaker on connection pool size 3) automated traffic-shift playbook refinement.
Alex W: handoff plan — I'm taking the incident until stabilization window ends. Sam, if anything regresses please page again. We'll reconvene in 30m for formal postmortem kickoff.
Sam O (oncall): acknowledged. I'll stay on watch.
IncidentBot: Incident updated to "mitigated" — monitoring for 30m. Notifications: #status, #support, #exec updated.
Mira C: thanks team. Please link the postmortem here when ready. :thumbsup:
Anna P: adding ticket IDs to the case notes and customer emails.
Jordan (SRE): saved logs & timeline to /incidents/1777777777/runbook and will attach to postmortem.
Alex W: closing thread for now; leaving monitoring. Good work everyone.
